name: metadata
query: query PerformanceMetadata { _meta { block { number hash timestamp } deployment hasIndexingErrors } }

name: character-page
query: query PerformanceCharacters { characters(first: 25, orderBy: tokenId, orderDirection: asc) { id tokenId owner { id characterCount } traits { tribe background } } }

name: owner-leaderboard
query: query PerformanceOwners { owners(first: 25, orderBy: characterCount, orderDirection: desc) { id characterCount characters(first: 5) { id tokenId } } }
